label: Maximum floor area of a ground-level conservatory or porch extension exempt from the Building Regulations
quote: CLASS 7 Extensions The extension of a building by the addition at ground level of— (a) a conservatory, porch, covered yard or covered way; or (b) a carport open on at least two sides; where the floor area of that extension does not exceed 30m2, provided that in the case of a conservatory or porch which is wholly or partly glazed, the glazing satisfies the requirements of … Part K4, K5.1, K5.2, K5.3, and K5.4 … Part N of Schedule 1.
scope: England. The Building Regulations 2010, Schedule 2 (exempt buildings and work), Class 7; the glazing must still satisfy the Schedule 1 requirements the quote names. Stated in the lowriskquotes conservatory cost guide.
